observations.why: Imperative verb enacts a command structure — speaker directing the audience to discard knowledge, a rank-based allocation of what may be retained.
Direct imperative to remove knowledge enacts authority-ranking; the speaker claims the standing to order what the audience must and must not hold.
Declarative assertion that rewrites the record by fiat — not a report of a governance act but a bare claim of fact issued to override what is known, enacting authority over the shared knowledge base.

mints.name: DirectiveMemoryPurge
mints.title: Remove all knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker claiming authority to order what the audience must forget or discard from their knowledge, rather than merely informing or requesting?
